package fixture

import (
	"os/exec"
	"testing"
)

type recorder struct{ calls []string }

func (r *recorder) Command(name string) { r.calls = append(r.calls, name) }

// exec here is a local value: exec.Command is recorder's method, and no child
// is started. os/exec is imported for its types.
func TestLocalShadow(t *testing.T) {
	var _ *exec.Cmd
	exec := &recorder{}
	exec.Command("luau")
	if len(exec.calls) != 1 {
		t.Fatal(exec.calls)
	}
}
